payload.claim: The docstring claims `_slug_for_text` never calls `follow_up._slug("")`, but `intake.Spec.title` is typed as plain `str` with no `min_length` or non-blank constraint (saffron/intake.py:165), so a parsed reply with `title: ""` passes validation and `follow_up._slug(parsed.title)` is called with an empty string. The claim is falsifiable even though the fallback value ("follow-up") happens to match the already-acknowledged no-letters case, so this is a documentation inaccuracy rather than a behavioral bug.
